description: This file implements a lockfile utility for managing file locks, including acquiring, releasing, and updating locks with support for stale lock detection and retries. It uses Node.js modules like 'path', 'fs', 'retry', and 'signal-exit'.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Asynchronously acquires a lock on a specified file with options for retries and stale detection.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired lock on a specified file.
